title: Don’t but it! Waste of money!
text: I’ve been a subscriber for a while now and I’m not using any of it! One month I threw most of it right out! The colors are horrible. I realize I may not like them all but glitter gloss?! Two months in a row I got one of the products twice! I don’t even like it. AND- one is an eye shadow! It’s supposed to be a lip bag! Complete waste of money! I canceled and then they shipped this month anyway!!!
label: negative
